info.title: Cloudflare Workers AI model wire types
info.description: Pinned official per-model JSON schemas. See cloudflare/sources.json for upstream content hashes. The account run API OpenAPI union omits System One models.

oneOf.description: The text to embed
Batch of text values to embed

pooling.description: The pooling method used in the embedding process. `cls` pooling will generate more accurate embeddings on larger inputs - however, embeddings created with cls pooling are not compatible with embeddings generated with mean pooling. The default pooling method is `mean` in order for this to not be a breaking change, but we highly suggest using the new `cls` pooling for better accuracy.

requests.description: Batch of the embeddings requests to run using async-queue

oneOf.description: The text to embed
Batch of text values to embed

pooling.description: The pooling method used in the embedding process. `cls` pooling will generate more accurate embeddings on larger inputs - however, embeddings created with cls pooling are not compatible with embeddings generated with mean pooling. The default pooling method is `mean` in order for this to not be a breaking change, but we highly suggest using the new `cls` pooling for better accuracy.

query.description: A query you wish to perform against the provided contexts.

top_k.description: Number of returned results starting with the best score.

contexts.description: List of provided contexts. Note that the index in this array is important, as the response will refer to it.

state.description: The text to read and predict from. Must be non-empty unless images are sent. Text answers are spans of this string.

fields.description: Required. Map of field name to a typed field spec. At least one field; no upper limit. Fields that do not fit next to the state in one 8,192-token pass are split across parallel passes.

unit.description: Unit label. For durations, one of seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years (default seconds).

decimals.description: Numbers, durations and number lists only.

min.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

max.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

step.description: Estimate grid: a positive number (days for date estimates), or "month" / "year".

null_threshold.description: Probability of null above which the value is null (default 0.5).

images.description: Optional embedded PNG, JPEG or WebP images placed before the state (max 4; 4 MiB each, 8 MiB total decoded; request body max 16 MiB). Remote URLs are not accepted.

reference_date.description: ISO date that anchors dates written without a year.

answers.description: One answer per field, keyed by field name. value is null when the input does not determine it.

steps.description: Forecast only: one estimate per step.

model.description: Required. The model selector: "clef" for @cf/cloudflare/clef, "clef-flash" for @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash.

state.description: Required. The content to evaluate: a string, or structured data (object/array) such as records, chat logs, or application state. Long text state is truncated to fit the model's token limit.

questions.description: Map of question id to a typed question (noul, choice, or score). 1 to 64 questions; ids may use letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' (max 100 chars). Answers are returned under the same ids.

oneOf.title: Noul
oneOf.description: A yes/no question. Returns the probability the answer is yes.

instructions.description: Required. The yes/no question to evaluate: a non-empty string, or an object/array that holds the question in one field and referenced data in others.

criteria.description: Optional descriptions of what a yes and a no mean.

oneOf.title: Choice
oneOf.description: Pick one option from a set you define. Returns the chosen option, a probability per option, and confidence.

instructions.description: Required. What the model should decide: a non-empty string, or an object/array holding the question and referenced data.

criteria.description: Map of option id (non-empty string) to its description: string, object, array, or null when no detail is needed. 2 to 255 options.

oneOf.title: Score
oneOf.description: Rate the state on an ordered rubric. Returns a probability-weighted score, a probability per level, and confidence.

instructions.description: Required. What the model should rate: a non-empty string, or an object/array holding the question and referenced data.

criteria.description: Ordered level descriptions (string, object, or array), lowest first; levels are indexed from 0. 2 to 10 levels.

images.description: Clef extension to the System One API. Optional embedded PNG, JPEG, or WebP images placed before the state (max 4; 4 MiB and 16 megapixels each, 8 MiB total decoded; whole request body max 13 MiB). Remote URLs are not accepted.

anyOf.title: Data URL
anyOf.description: A base64 data URL: data:image/png;base64,..., data:image/jpeg;base64,..., or data:image/webp;base64,...

model.description: The model that performed the evaluation.

answers.description: One answer per question, keyed by the question ids from the request.

probabilities.description: Probability per option/level; values sum to 1.

confidence.description: How certain the model is, derived from the probabilities.

score.description: Probability-weighted level; can land between levels.

legend.description: Level index (string) mapped to its description.

probabilities.description: Probability per option/level; values sum to 1.

confidence.description: How certain the model is, derived from the probabilities.

text.description: The text that you want to classify

DistilbertSst2Int8Output.description: An array of classification results for the input text

source_lang.description: The language code of the source text (e.g., 'en' for English). Defaults to 'en' if not specified

target_lang.description: The language code to translate the text into (e.g., 'es' for Spanish)

requests.description: Batch of the embeddings requests to run using async-queue

translated_text.description: The translated text in the target language

anyOf.description: Base64 encoded value of the audio data.

language.description: The language of the audio being transcribed or translated.

vad_filter.description: Preprocess the audio with a voice activity detection model.

initial_prompt.description: A text prompt to help provide context to the model on the contents of the audio.

prefix.description: The prefix appended to the beginning of the output of the transcription and can guide the transcription result.

beam_size.description: The number of beams to use in beam search decoding. Higher values may improve accuracy at the cost of speed.

condition_on_previous_text.description: Whether to condition on previous text during transcription. Setting to false may help prevent hallucination loops.

no_speech_threshold.description: Threshold for detecting no-speech segments. Segments with no-speech probability above this value are skipped.

compression_ratio_threshold.description: Threshold for filtering out segments with high compression ratio, which often indicate repetitive or hallucinated text.

log_prob_threshold.description: Threshold for filtering out segments with low average log probability, indicating low confidence.

hallucination_silence_threshold.description: Optional threshold (in seconds) to skip silent periods that may cause hallucinations.

text.description: The complete transcription of the audio.

word_count.description: The total number of words in the transcription.

vtt.description: The transcription in WebVTT format, which includes timing and text information for use in subtitles.

prompt.description: The input text prompt for the model to generate a response.

lora.description: Name of the LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) model to fine-tune the base model.

raw.description: If true, a chat template is not applied and you must adhere to the specific model's expected formatting.

stream.description: If true, the response will be streamed back incrementally using SSE, Server Sent Events.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

temperature.description: Controls the randomness of the output; higher values produce more random results.

top_p.description: Adjusts the creativity of the AI's responses by controlling how many possible words it considers. Lower values make outputs more predictable; higher values allow for more varied and creative responses.

top_k.description: Limits the AI to choose from the top 'k' most probable words. Lower values make responses more focused; higher values introduce more variety and potential surprises.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility of the generation.

repetition_penalty.description: Penalty for repeated tokens; higher values discourage repetition.

frequency_penalty.description: Decreases the likelihood of the model repeating the same lines verbatim.

presence_penalty.description: Increases the likelihood of the model introducing new topics.

messages.description: An array of message objects representing the conversation history.

tools.description: A list of tools available for the assistant to use.

name.description: The name of the tool. More descriptive the better.

description.description: A brief description of what the tool does.

type.description: Specifies the type of tool (e.g., 'function').
